summary: Changed one() and only() in more_itertools/more.py to test `too_long is not None` / `too_short is not None` instead of the falsy `raise too_long or ValueError(msg)` pattern, so falsy custom exception instances are raised. The default ValueError message is now built inline only in the fallback branch, so it is never evaluated (and never reprs the items) when a custom exception is supplied. Removed the `msg` variable in both functions. Docstrings untouched. `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_more.py` passes: 609 passed, 11313 subtests passed.
